name: Telephone
description: Defines a field type for telephone numbers.
version_note: This is core's Telephone module continued as contrib after removal from Drupal core. Source info.yml declares core_version_requirement '^11.3 || ^12', so 1.0.x installs on Drupal 11.3+; on core that still ships the module the identical core version is used (same machine name and plugin ids). 1.0.x is a copy of core; 2.0.x is the forward development branch.
project_description:
This is the landing spot of core Telephone module after it was deprecated.

 Branches 
 2.0.x = development branch going forward.

1.0.x = copy of core.

 Notes 
 Users who are on 11.3 may need to add to their composer files

 

"replace": {

 "drupal/telephone": "*"

 },
